summary: Red-phase test-writing run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Two permanent Swift test files and the criterion/delta plan doc are committed; no Swift toolchain exists in this container, so no test was executed locally. Expected red state: OpenAPISpecCoverageTests fails 3/3 by design (no vendored spec at iOS/OpenAPI/, no swift-openapi-generator/runtime in Package.swift, no ColorMatchingOpenAPI target - all inspectable at this commit); OpenAPIClientStubbedResponseTests is canImport-gated (compiles inert, 0 tests) until the implementation run adds the generated target and package deps. Upstream spec (viamin/color_matching#110) is unfetchable here: GitHub API proxy returns Repository mismatch for cross-repo access, so prose-vs-spec reconciliation deltas (D1-D6 seeded in docs/openapi-client-test-plan.md) must be completed when the spec is vendored. Execution evidence for all criteria is deferred to CI swift test on macOS at the implementation PR head.
